_comment: One entry per upload. publish.mjs reads this and runs bed → video → upload. Every stage is resumable: existing files are reused, so a re-run after a failure picks up where it stopped.

w2tue.title: The Full NYSE Session — 6.5 Hours of Focus Music, Open to Close
w2tue.description:
Six and a half hours of original baroque-inspired instrumental music — the exact length of the New York trading session, 9:30 to 16:00 ET.

The view moves through the day with you: dark before the open, bright through the morning, warming into the afternoon, dusk at the close. Glance up and you know roughly where you are without checking the clock.

Steady tempo, no vocals, no dynamic swells, nothing that competes for the attention you are spending elsewhere.

Every piece is original and produced for this channel.

▸ Best for: the full trading session, long analysis days, deep work blocks
▸ Tempo: around 60 BPM
▸ Length: 6 hours 30 minutes — open to close

New sessions every Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday.
